name: volatility
description: Advanced memory forensics framework for incident response and malware analysis

tools.description: Extract digital artifacts from volatile memory (RAM) dumps for forensic analysis
tools.usage:
vol -f memory.dmp imageinfo # Identify OS and profile
vol -f memory.dmp --profile=Win10x64 pslist # List running processes
vol -f memory.dmp --profile=Win10x64 netscan # Network connections
vol -f memory.dmp --profile=Win10x64 malfind # Find malware artifacts
vol -f memory.dmp --profile=Win10x64 hashdump # Extract password hashes

tools.description: GUI interface for Volatility memory forensics with visual analysis capabilities
tools.usage: VolatilityWorkbench # Launch GUI interface\nVolatilityWorkbench memory.dmp # Open memory dump in GUI\nVolatilityWorkbench --help # Show available options
